summary: vars/podYaml.groovy meets P3's outcome: sidecars match Build-Main #558's printed pod, string and map images: entries render with the library defaults, the three required refusals hold, all @NonCPS, and PodYamlTest asserts whole outputs including P4's exact call. Two advisory edge behaviours (invalid derived container names, null env value) ride along in the close-out report.

findings.summary: A string images: entry whose last path segment holds '.' or '_' renders a container name Kubernetes refuses at pod creation
An env value of null renders as the string "null" with no refusal
